title: Gimbal UFO video argument between Marik von Rennenkampff and Mick West

tellings.quote: been having this argument around the gimbal UFO video with a a gentleman named Mick W

plain: Two men have been in a running public argument over the Gimbal video, a military video of an unidentified flying object: on one side Marik von Rennenkampff, on the other a man named Mick West. The journalist Michael Shellenberger mentions the dispute on Jesse Michels's show in November 2024, naming both men. He brings it up as an example of the fight over whether such videos show something truly unexplained.
